senses.sense_definition: Willing to do what pleases others; obliging and eager to agree.

examples.text: The host was overly <w>complaisant</w>, immediately agreeing to every unreasonable demand made by the guests.
He maintained a <w>complaisant</w> manner simply to prevent conflicts in the office.

senses.sense_definition: Submissive or yielding readily to the wishes or demands of others.

examples.text: A <w>complaisant</w> legislature approved the controversial law without questioning any of its clauses.
The dictator relied on a <w>complaisant</w> press to hide the true extent of the crisis.

senses.sense_definition: Courteous, polite, or showing respect toward someone.

examples.text: He bowed with <w>complaisant</w> grace as he welcomed the foreign ambassadors.
Her manners were remarkably <w>complaisant</w>, earning praise from the older members of the court.

traits.comment: Used in archaic or historical contexts for polite or courteous behavior.
